title.en: Europe heatwave live: drought fears in Italy, records broken in Slovakia and Denmark, and 700 flights delayed in England
title.zh: 德国严阵以待“远超40摄氏度”高温，欧洲热浪东移

summary.en: Forecasters warn that Germany and central and eastern Europe are preparing for temperatures "well over 40C" as a heatwave spreads. All 16 German states are under an "extreme heat" warning.
summary.zh: 气象预报员警告称，随着热浪向中欧和东欧蔓延，德国将迎来“远超40摄氏度”的高温。德国所有16个州都已发布“极端高温”预警。

body.en: Forecasters say hottest conditions spreading into central and eastern Europe After decades of climate warnings, why is Europe so unprepared for rising heat? Seawater is seeping into Italy’s longest river as the waterway starts to run dry in the heatwave, hitting a farming heartland that produces the milk for Parmesan cheese. The Po River has never fallen this low so early in the year, raising fears of a devastating drought in July in this corner of northern Italy. Continue reading...
body.zh: 预报员表示，最热的天气正在蔓延至中欧和东欧。德国气象局已向全德国发出高温警报。所有 16 个州都收到高温警告，其中大部分被归类为“极端高温”。 “热浪今天将达到顶峰。预计全线气温将超过 36 摄氏度，局部最高温度可能高达 42 摄氏度，”该公司在 Bluesky 上发布的一篇帖子中表示。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Europe braces for extreme heat, we are reminded of creation's vulnerability and its deep connection to human actions. Yahweh's creation groans under the weight of environmental stress, calling us to reflect on our stewardship of the earth. In these challenging times, we are invited to care for our common home and one another.
reflection.zh: 随着欧洲准备迎接极端高温，我们再次被提醒创造物的脆弱性及其与人类行为的深刻联系。雅伟的创造物在环境压力的重负下呻吟，呼唤我们反思对地球的管家职责。在这些充满挑战的时刻，我们受邀关爱我们共同的家园和彼此。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Newborn baby rescued from Venezuela earthquake rubble
title.zh: 新生婴儿从委内瑞拉地震废墟中获救

summary.en: Two powerful earthquakes struck Venezuela, causing the deaths of at least 920 people. Amidst the devastation, a newborn baby was successfully rescued from the rubble.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉发生两次强烈地震，造成至少920人死亡。在灾难中，一名新生婴儿从废墟中被成功救出。

body.en:
This is the moment rescuers pulled a newborn baby from beneath the rubble of a collapsed building, after two deadly earthquakes hit Venezuela.

Videos shared on social media show rescuers in the city of La Guaira moving the baby away from the rubble and handing it over to a man, who appears to be the father. The mother was also pulled alive from the rubble a while later, AFP reports.

Rescue efforts are continuing in the country, after back-to-back quakes struck the country, killing at least 920 people and injuring more than 3,360.
body.zh: 这是委内瑞拉发生两次致命地震后，救援人员从倒塌建筑物废墟下救出一名新生婴儿的时刻。 社交媒体上分享的视频显示，拉瓜伊拉市的救援人员将婴儿从废墟中移开，并将其交给一名男子，这名男子似乎是孩子的父亲。据法新社报道，不久后，这名母亲也被从废墟中救了出来。 该国连续发生地震，造成至少 920 人死亡、超过 3,360 人受伤，救援工作仍在继续。

reflection.en: Amidst the profound sorrow and loss caused by the earthquakes, the rescue of a newborn baby offers a poignant moment of hope. This small miracle reminds us that even when grief seems overwhelming, Yahweh can bring unexpected joy and light into the darkest of times.
reflection.zh: 在地震造成的深切悲痛和损失中，一名新生婴儿获救带来了令人动容的希望。这个小小的奇迹提醒我们，即使悲伤似乎难以承受，雅伟也能在最黑暗的时刻带来意想不到的喜乐和光明。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: Australia to double penalty for social media ban breaches to $99m as tech giants accused of ‘not doing enough’
title.zh: 澳大利亚将社交媒体禁令违规罚款翻倍至9900万澳元，科技巨头被指“做得不够”

summary.en: Australia is increasing penalties for social media companies that fail to enforce age bans, with fines potentially reaching $99 million. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese stated that too many children are still accessing these platforms, and the new measures aim to hold tech giants accountable.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚将把社交媒体公司违反年龄禁令的罚款提高一倍，最高可达9900万澳元。总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯表示，仍有太多儿童在使用这些平台，新措施旨在追究科技巨头的责任。

body.en: Prime minister Anthony Albanese says too many children still on platforms but he is ‘heartened’ by world-leading law Social media bans go global: big tech faces a reckoning after Australia’s crackdown Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The federal government will double the penalty for breaches of Australia’s youth social media ban to $99m, arguing tech companies are “not doing enough” to keep children off harmful social media sites. And the eSafety commissioner, now investigating potential breaches of the law by Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok and YouTube, will have its information-gathering powers strengthened under proposed further reforms. Continue reading...
body.zh: 总理安东尼·艾博尼斯表示仍有太多儿童使用平台，但他对世界领先的法律感到“鼓舞” 社交媒体禁令走向全球：澳大利亚镇压后大型科技公司面临清算 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 联邦政府将对违反澳大利亚青少年社交媒体禁令的罚款增加一倍，达到 9900 万美元，并认为科技公司在阻止儿童远离有害社交媒体网站方面“做得不够”。电子安全专员目前正在调查 Facebook、Instagram、Snapchat、TikTok 和 YouTube 的潜在违法行为，并将根据拟议的进一步改革加强其信息收集权力。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the critical need to protect children in the digital age, holding powerful platforms accountable for their impact on the young. Yahweh's word reminds us of the profound responsibility to safeguard children from anything that might cause them to stumble or be harmed. It calls us to consider how our societal structures and technologies...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调了在数字时代保护儿童的迫切需要，并要求强大的平台对其对年轻一代的影响负责。雅伟的话语提醒我们，有责任保护儿童免受任何可能导致他们跌倒或受害的事物。它呼吁我们思考，我们的社会结构和技术是如何滋养或危及我们中最脆弱群体的。

verse.textEn: If anyone causes one of these little ones — those who believe in me — to stumble, it would be better for them to have a large millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
verse.textZh: 凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，沉在深海里。
verse.themeEn: Woe to those who harm children

title.en: ‘I’m missing out’: the cash-strapped UK university students forced to live at home
title.zh: 英国贫困大学生因经济拮据被迫住在家中，“我错过了很多”

summary.en: Experts warn that university students from poorer backgrounds in the UK are increasingly forced to limit their educational and career options due to financial difficulties. One student, Mariam, 19, often waits hours between lectures and career events because she cannot afford to live closer to University College...
summary.zh: 专家警告称，英国贫困家庭的大学生因经济困难，越来越被迫限制他们的教育和职业选择。19岁的学生玛丽亚姆就是其中之一，她经常在伦敦大学学院的讲座和职业活动之间等待数小时，因为她负担不起住在学校附近。

body.en: Experts say students from poorer backgrounds increasingly having to limit their options because of money worries Most days, Mariam spends hours simply waiting. The 19-year-old University College London student often finishes her lectures by mid-morning but has careers events or society meetings in the evening. The three-hour round trip to her family home means travelling back and forth makes little sense, so she waits on campus instead. More often than not, by the time the event starts, she is too exhausted to stay long. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家表示，由于经济担忧，来自贫困家庭的学生越来越多地不得不限制自己的选择。大多数时候，玛丽雅姆只是花几个小时等待。这位 19 岁的伦敦大学学院学生经常在上午结束学业，但晚上还要参加职业活动或社交会议。往返她家需要三个小时，这意味着来回没有什么意义，所以她在校园里等待。通常，当活动开始时，她已经筋疲力尽，无法停留太久。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report on cash-strapped students underscores how financial barriers can restrict access to vital opportunities, limiting the potential of young people. Yahweh's desire is for justice to flow like a river, ensuring that all individuals, regardless of their economic background, have the freedom to pursue their calling and contribute to society.
reflection.zh: 这篇关于经济拮据学生的报道强调了经济障碍如何限制人们获得重要机会，从而限制了年轻人的潜力。雅伟渴望公义如江河般涌流，确保所有个体，无论其经济背景如何，都能自由地追求自己的呼召并为社会做出贡献。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

body.en: Court files show how men connected through TikTok and encrypted apps planned attack on White House UFC fight When Tycen Proper, 19, finished high school, his family gave him at least $3,000 of “graduation money”, according to court documents. Despite the generosity, he seemed content to just live at his parents’ home, in a tiny Ohio town near Amish country, and spend more and more time on the internet. But Proper did have ambition of a kind, an affidavit says . He quit his job to focus on a special project that he was planning with friends from the internet. His mother saw him studying maps of Washington DC. He also put his graduation money into investments that made his father uneasy: a rifle, a shotgun, body armor, ammunition. Continue reading...

title.en: US strikes Iran after attack on cargo ship
title.zh: 美国在货船遇袭后对伊朗实施打击

summary.en: The United States Central Command announced it conducted strikes on missile and drone storage facilities and coastal radar positions in Iran. This action followed a prior attack on a cargo ship.
summary.zh: 美国中央司令部宣布，已对伊朗境内的导弹和无人机储存设施以及沿海雷达阵地进行了打击。此举是在此前一艘货船遭到袭击后采取的。

body.en:
The US military has conducted strikes on Iranian targets after President Donald Trump accused Iran of a "foolish violation" of its truce following an attack on a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

US Central Command said it had struck missile and drone storage facilities and coastal radar positions on Friday, in response to a drone attack on a cargo ship on Thursday which halted a planned evacuation of sailors stuck in the region.

Tehran said the cargo ship was attacked because it was using an unauthorised route to transit through the Gulf waterway.

After the US strikes, Iran in turn accused the US of violating their interim deal and said it had struck targets linked to American forces.

US Central Command - or Centcom - described the American strikes as "a powerful response" to the drone attack a day earlier.

"The unwarranted aggression against commercial shipping by Iranian forces clearly violated the ceasefire," it said in a statement.

"Furthermore, Iran's dangerous behaviour undermined freedom of navigation as commerce increasingly flows through the vital international trade corridor."

Centcom said the US military would "continue to provide safe passage coordination and support to commercial vessels transiting the strait".

Iran's foreign ministry released a statement on Saturday morning, saying the country had carried out strikes against targets linked to American forces in response, and blamed the "treaty-breaking US regime" for the situation.

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said its navy had struck US military positions in the region, without providing further details. The BBC contacted the Pentagon for comment.

Bahrain's foreign ministry said the country had come under attack from "several Iranian drones" early on Saturday, condemning the action as a "flagrant violation" of its sovereignty and accusing Tehran of undermining peace efforts.

Also on Saturday, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said a tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.

The vessel sustained damage to its bridge, but all crew were safe and no environmental damage had been reported, UKMTO added.

Tehran effectively closed the strait after US and Israeli attacks against Iran began at the end of February.

The shutdown of the critical waterway for oil and gas shipments caused a spike in global oil prices and choked off shipments of other crucial commodities such as fertiliser.

The US and Iran agreed on 17 June to end hostilities under a 14-point memorandum of understanding, which had also called for Iran to use its "best efforts for the safe passage of commercial vessels with no charge for 60 days".

body.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普总统指责伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡袭击一艘货船后“愚蠢地违反”停战协议后，美国军方对伊朗目标进行了打击。 周四，这艘船被一架单向攻击无人机击中，没有人员伤亡的报道，这一事件促使计划疏散滞留在该地区的数千名水手。 作为回应，美国中央司令部周五表示，它袭击了导弹和无人机储存设施以及沿海雷达阵地。伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）指责美国和以色列。 就在袭击宣布前不久，当被问及美国是否会反击伊朗时，特朗普表示“你会看到的”。 美国中央司令部（Centcom）将这次袭击描述为对无人机袭击的“有力回应”。 “伊朗军队对商业航运的无端侵略显然违反了停火协议，”它在一份声明中表示。 “此外，随着商业越来越多地流经重要的国际贸易走廊，伊朗的危险行为破坏了航行自由。” 中央司令部表示，美军将“继续为通过海峡的商船提供安全通行协调和支持”。 目前尚不清楚美国的袭击是孤立的还是构成更大规模、持续的反应的一部分。 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队周五晚些时候在一份声明中表示：“违反条约的美国政权一如既往地违反其承诺，以一艘船只违反霍尔木兹海峡未经授权的航线为借口，对伊朗伊斯兰共和国海岸发动了空袭。” 它补充说：“如果侵略再次发生，我们的反应将比这更广泛。” 伊斯兰革命卫队还指责“犹太复国主义政权”——指的是以色列——违反了黎巴嫩的停火协议。 周五，以色列和黎巴嫩在华盛顿签署了和平计划框架协议。尽管已经停火，但以色列军队和伊朗支持的真主党之间最近在黎巴嫩南部仍在继续进行有限的战斗。 在美国和以色列于二月底开始袭击伊朗后，德黑兰实际上关闭了该海峡。 石油和天然气运输关键水道的关闭导致全球油价飙升，并阻碍了化肥等其他重要商品的运输。 美国和伊朗于 6 月 17 日同意根据 14 点谅解备忘录结束敌对行动，该备忘录还呼吁伊朗“尽最大努力确保商船在 60 天内免费安全通行”。 在美国实施报复性打击后，副总统 JD 万斯在 X 上发帖称，如果伊朗“对谅解备忘录的实施方式存在分歧，他们可以拿起电话”。 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队主席易卜拉欣·阿齐兹...

reflection.en: The news of retaliatory strikes highlights the persistent challenge of breaking cycles of violence. In such moments, Yahweh's word reminds us not to be overcome by evil, but to actively seek ways to overcome evil with good. This calls for wisdom and courage to pursue paths that lead away from endless escalation.
reflection.zh: 报复性打击的消息凸显了打破暴力循环的持续挑战。在这样的时刻，雅伟的话语提醒我们不要被恶所胜，而要积极寻求以善胜恶的途径。这呼吁我们以智慧和勇气去追求那些能避免无休止升级的道路。

title.en: Military-age Ukrainian men could lose EU protection
title.zh: 军事年龄乌克兰男性或将失去欧盟保护

summary.en: The European Commission has suggested withdrawing protection status for military-age Ukrainian males. A number of EU countries support the move — and so does Kyiv.
summary.zh: 欧盟委员会提议取消对军事年龄乌克兰男性的临时保护身份，此举得到了多个欧盟国家和乌克兰本国的支持。

body.en:
The European Commission has suggested withdrawing protection status for military-age Ukrainian males. A number of EU countries support the move — and so does Kyiv.

"Our proposal provides that temporary protection should not be granted to newly arriving persons who are not allowed to leave Ukraine because of their military obligations," said Magnus Brunner, the European commissioner for internal affairs and migration, while announcing proposed changes to European protective status for Ukrainians on Friday.

Protection status for Ukrainians as such should remain in place, said Brunner at a meeting of EU interior ministers in Luxembourg in early June, though new conditions could apply.

Ukrainians forced to flee their country as a result of Russia's invasion of their homeland have enjoyed temporary protection status in the EU since March 2022.

That status is set to end in early March 2027, and must now be extended before it expires. The difference between this status and asylum is that the protection is temporary and those entering the bloc are not subject to individual case-by-case review.

The proposal by the European Commission is formulated in gender-neutral terms, emphasized one EU official. But ultimately, it will most likely affect men between the ages of 23 and 60. The update worked out in the new proposal — which does not apply to Ukrainians already in the EU — would only come into effect when the Council of Europe officially approves and publishes it in the Official Journal of the European Union, underscored another Commission official.

On March 31, the EU's statistics agency Eurostat counted a total of 4.33 million Ukrainians living in the bloc under temporary protection status. Of these, nearly 1.3 million (29.4% of the EU total) were in Germany , followed by 950,000 in Poland (22.2% of the total) and 380,000 in the Czech Republic (8.8%). Slightly more than one-quarter of those in the bloc were adult males, said the agency.

Michael O'Flaherty, commissioner for human rights at the Council of Europe — which is not an EU institution — criticized the proposal. O'Flaherty expressed concern over "mounting pressure to prematurely end temporary protection arrangements" and to limit access for military-age males, among others. The commissioner said that now is the time for "more solidarity, not less." 

The EU has justified the new proposal by saying Ukraine had requested the move, and that Kyiv's need to impress military obligations upon its own citizens to defend itself were legitimate. Brunner said Friday that the proposal had been put forth in coordination with EU member states.

title.en: Venezuela earthquakes kill 920 people as international rescue teams arrive
title.zh: 委内瑞拉地震造成920人死亡，国际救援队抵达

summary.en: A powerful earthquake in Venezuela has claimed 920 lives, with hundreds more feared trapped under rubble. International rescue teams are arriving as desperate families await news of their loved ones.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉发生强烈地震，已造成920人死亡，另有数百人恐仍被困在废墟下。国际救援队正在陆续抵达，绝望的家庭焦急等待着亲人的消息。

body.en:
More than 900 people have been killed and 3,360 others injured in the Venezuela earthquakes, according to the government, as rescuers keep searching for survivors and families wait desperately for news.

The injured are being treated in makeshift medical facilities after dozens of buildings in the country's north were destroyed by the two quakes, including in the capital Caracas.

UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher says almost 2,000 international rescue workers are part of the response.

Two powerful earthquakes rocked Venezuela within seconds of each other on Wednesday. The second quake was one of the strongest tremors to hit the country in a century, at a magnitude of 7.5.

La Guaira, a region north of the capital, has been hit the hardest, officials said. The state is also home to one of the country's two main ports and to Simón Bolívar International Airport in Maiquetía - the country's main airport.

Many people are missing, and it is likely the death toll will rise as rescue efforts continue.

In La Guaira, Natacha Diaz told the BBC that her two daughters - aged 22 and 23 - were trapped under the rubble of a collapsed shopping centre, where they worked as manicurists.

"They were with their friends," she said. "I just want them to be found. I have faith and hope that they are there."

National assembly head Jorge Rodriguez said in a state TV broadcast on Friday that the death toll had reached 920, with at least 172 people still believed to be trapped.

In La Guaira alone, at least 243 people have been rescued, the top lawmaker - who is the interim president's brother - said.

Dozens of people have been rescued alive, which "brings us joy that they can embrace their families and loved ones", Acting President Delcy Rodríguez said at a televised briefing on Friday.

On Saturday, the UN's Tom Fletcher told BBC Radio 4's Today programme teams were surging in, as the first 72 hours after the earthquake were "crucial".

"It's absolutely grim, it's devastating and for us we are driven on minute by minute, hour by hour, by the sound of the survivors underneath the rubble."

"We cannot pause for a second while we hear them, but the worst thing is when those voices go quiet. We're determined to save as many lives as we can."

Hundreds of buildings have been damaged or destroyed, including a number of hospitals and shopping centres, Jorge Rodríguez said, adding that at least 1,000 other infrastructure sites have also been damaged.

Surviving medical facilities are said to be overwhelmed, with medics telling the BBC that even before the disaster it was difficult to treat patients.

"All our hospitals lack supplies, lack medicines, we are not able to provide medical attention to our people in a normal day," doctor Pedro Javier Fernandez said.

title.en: Socceroos to face Egypt in World Cup knockout after dramatic Group G finish
title.zh: 澳大利亚队在G组戏剧性收官后将在世界杯淘汰赛中对阵埃及队

summary.en: Australia's World Cup knockout opponent was only decided in the dying moments of the final Group G matches, setting the stage for a dramatic clash with Egypt.

body.en:
Australia will face Egypt in the World Cup Round of 32 after the Pharaohs held on to finish second in Group G following a dramatic final round of matches.

Egypt sealed its place in the knockout rounds on Saturday afternoon (AEST) with a 1-1 draw against Iran, but was denied top spot in Group G after Belgium thrashed New Zealand 5-1 to edge the Pharaohs on goal difference.

That means Australia will face Egypt in the Round of 32 at Arlington, Texas, at 4am AEST next Saturday. The two sides have never met at a World Cup before.

It's still unclear whether Egyptian star player Mohamed Salah will play in the match.

Salah — who became one of the English Premier League's most celebrated players after signing with Liverpool in 2017 — came off in the 57th minute in the Egypt-Iran match and was seen having his left leg bandaged.

The Group G standings changed several times throughout the simultaneous matches, with Belgium, Iran and Egypt all sitting second in the group at various times.

In their match against Egypt , Iran scored a stoppage-time goal, which was ruled offside by VAR. Had the goal stood, Iran would have finished second and played Australia next Saturday.

They now face an agonising wait to see if they qualify as one of the top eight third-placed teams.

After a 1-5 defeat to Belgium, New Zealand finished last in the group with one point and were eliminated from the tournament.

Former Socceroo Harry Kewell, speaking before the results were announced, told SBS that Belgium and Egypt looked to be the most dangerous of Australia's opponents.

"Once you get through the group stages, which they successfully navigated through, it's all about now.

"This is where you have to play your best football. This is where you have to strike when your chances are low, you've got to be able to be clinical, and hopefully we can do that and progress one step further."

The challenge for the Australian side will be to play their best football with a couple of players out of action.

The Socceroos are down to a 24-player squad after the injured Jacob Italiano and Mathew Leckie left camp for Austria and Melbourne, respectively.

Italiano played against Türkiye and the United States but was injured at training, while Leckie hurt his hamstring in the side's 2-0 defeat to the US.

Australia have played Egypt twice before, winning a President's Cup match on penalties in 1987. They lost a friendly in Cairo 3-0 in 2010.

title.en: Socceroos stop the nation as Australia v Paraguay smashes World Cup viewing records
title.zh: 澳大利亚队对巴拉圭的比赛打破世界杯收视纪录，举国关注

summary.en: Australia's national football team, the Socceroos, drew a record-breaking 4.8 million viewers for their World Cup match against Paraguay, making it a significant national event.

body.en:
On Friday, records were broken when millions of Australians tuned in to see the Socceroos play their highest-stakes FIFA World Cup 2026 match so far.

Attracting nearly five million viewers, it was the most-watched World Cup match in history on SBS, according to national ratings rankings from Virtual Australia (VOZ).

Thrilled fans clamoured in pubs and live sites across the nation at midday on Friday, skipping work and school to witness Australia qualify for the knockout stage of the tournament with a draw against Paraguay,

After a crushing loss to the USA in their second group match of the tournament last week, Australia needed to either beat or tie with Paraguay to secure its spot in the next stage, the Round of 32.

A total of 4.844 million viewers and a total TV average audience of 3.086 million across linear television and digital streaming watched the Australia v Paraguay match.

It is the second most-watched broadcast in SBS history, behind the Socceroos' World Cup play-off victory against Uruguay in 2006 (3.416 million, national average audience).

The Paraguay-Australia post-match program attracted 2.872 million viewers, and the pre-match program attracted 2.277 million viewers.

Between live matches and pre- and post-match shows, SBS had the top three programs of the day and five of the top ten.

Cumulatively, 13.9 million Australians, or about half the population, have watched some of the matches in the FIFA World Cup tournament.

The Socceroos' next game is at 4am Saturday, 4 July (AEST) in Arlington, Texas, near Dallas, when they will face Egypt.

reflection.zh: 一场全国性的体育赛事能让数百万人团结在共同的兴奋之中，展现出集体的热情和对共同目标的追求。虽然这些时刻的欢呼和纪录令人激动，但雅伟提醒我们也要寻求那永不朽坏的、永恒价值的冠冕。这种视角帮助我们欣赏暂时的喜乐，同时将我们最深的盼望根植于真正持久的事物。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.

title.en: Billionaire Leon Black walks out of Epstein investigation hearing
title.zh: 亿万富翁莱昂·布莱克退出爱泼斯坦调查听证会

summary.en: A House panel issued subpoenas for billionaire Leon Black to testify on camera and under oath, after he walked out of a hearing related to the investigation into Jeffrey Epstein.
summary.zh: 在亿万富翁莱昂·布莱克退出与杰弗里·爱泼斯坦调查相关的听证会后，众议院小组向他发出了传票，要求他出镜宣誓作证。

body.en:
Billionaire investor Leon Black walked out of a closed-door hearing with the congressional committee investigating late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein after refusing to answer questions on non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), say lawmakers.

Black, whose name comes up in the Epstein files released by the justice department, testified voluntarily. But he left after he was asked about NDAs he may have signed, the panel chairman said.

The House of Representatives Oversight Committee issued two subpoenas for Black to share NDAs and give an on-camera deposition under oath.

Black left Apollo Global Management, which he co-founded, in 2021 amid scrutiny over his Epstein ties. He denies wrongdoing.

"We want to know, was Jeffrey Epstein involved in the NDAs?" the committee's Republican chairman, James Comer, said on Friday.

"Was he involved in writing? Was he involved in awarding funds to the women for the NDAs? What was the reason for the NDA? We want to know everything about the NDAs."

Nondisclosure agreements, commonly called NDAs, are contracts where both parties agree to keep information confidential, often as part of a settlement or employment agreement.

Black's attorneys confirmed to the BBC he walked out after his legal team "made their final comments".

The private equity tycoon hired Epstein as a wealth management adviser and allegedly spoke to him about personal matters, including extramarital affairs from which NDAs resulted, according to the BBC's media partner CBS News.

During his brief appearance on Friday, Black reportedly told the committee he had paid Epstein $158m (£120m) for legitimate purposes over the course of their years-long association.

That amount was the subject of a Senate investigation into whether Black had intentionally overpaid Epstein, cloaking money paid for personal reasons in the guise of financial services.

Black's attorneys have pointed out that an internal investigation at Apollo by the Dechert law firm concluded the fees that Black paid to Epstein were for legitimate tax advice.

Like many others who have spoken to the committee as it investigates Epstein's connections to the wealthy and powerful, Black said the disgraced financier had deceived him.

"I knew Jekyll. I didn't know Hyde," he said in his opening statement, a copy of which his lawyer shared with the BBC.

Black continued: "With the benefit of hindsight, I now know, as does the world, that Epstein was engaged in horrific, sordid activities. I feel terrible for Epstein's victims.

"I want to state clearly that I did not know about this nefarious activity until Epstein was charged with trafficking in July 2019."

body.zh: 议员们表示，亿万富翁投资者莱昂·布莱克在拒绝回答有关保密协议（NDAs）的问题后，退出了与国会委员会一起调查已故性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的闭门听证会。 布莱克的名字出现在司法部公布的爱泼斯坦档案中，他自愿作证。但该小组主席表示，在被问及他可能签署的保密协议后，他离开了。 众议院监督委员会向布莱克发出了两张传票，要求其分享保密协议，并在宣誓后在镜头前提供证词。 由于与爱泼斯坦的关系受到审查，布莱克于 2021 年离开了他共同创立的阿波罗全球管理公司。他否认有不当行为。 “我们想知道，杰弗里·爱泼斯坦是否参与了保密协议？”该委员会的共和党主席詹姆斯·科默周五表示。 “他是否参与了写作？他是否参与了向女性提供保密协议的资金？保密协议的原因是什么？我们想知道有关保密协议的一切。” 保密协议通常称为 NDA，是双方同意对信息保密的合同，通常作为和解或雇佣协议的一部分。 布莱克的律师向英国广播公司证实，在他的法律团队“做出最终评论”后，他退出了。 据英国广播公司的媒体合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，这位私募股权大亨聘请爱泼斯坦作为财富管理顾问，并据称与他谈论了个人事务，包括导致保密协议的婚外情。 据报道，布莱克在周五短暂露面期间告诉委员会，在他们多年的合作过程中，他已出于合法目的向爱泼斯坦支付了 1.58 亿美元（1.2 亿英镑）。 参议院调查布莱克是否故意多付爱泼斯坦费用，以金融服务的名义掩盖因个人原因支付的款项。 布莱克的律师指出，德杰特律师事务所对阿波罗的内部调查得出的结论是，布莱克向爱泼斯坦支付的费用是合法的税务建议。 与许多在调查爱泼斯坦与权贵关系的委员会中接受采访的其他人一样，布莱克表示，这位名誉扫地的金融家欺骗了他。 “我认识杰基尔。我不认识海德，”他在开场陈述中说道，他的律师向英国广播公司分享了开场陈述的副本。 布莱克继续说道：“事后看来，我和全世界都知道，爱泼斯坦从事了可怕、肮脏的活动。我为爱泼斯坦的受害者感到难过。” “我想明确表示，直到 2019 年 7 月爱泼斯坦被指控贩卖人口之前，我并不知道这一邪恶活动。” 布莱克否认曾经虐待过女性，或与未成年女性在一起，或性交易，或向爱泼斯坦支付与女性接触的费用，或……

reflection.en: The news of a powerful individual walking out of an investigation hearing highlights the ongoing struggle for accountability when justice seems to falter. Yahweh's word reminds us of the lament when the law is paralyzed and justice appears perverted, urging us to seek truth and fairness for all.

title.en: Ex-Trump adviser John Bolton pleads guilty to mishandling classified documents
title.zh: 美国前总统特朗普的顾问约翰·博尔顿承认处理机密文件不当

summary.en: Former Trump adviser John Bolton has pleaded guilty to charges of mishandling classified documents. Prosecutors state he faces a potential prison sentence of up to five years and has agreed to pay a fine of $2.25 million.
summary.zh: 检方表示，美国前总统特朗普的顾问约翰·博尔顿已承认处理机密文件不当的指控。他可能面临最高五年的监禁，并已同意支付225万美元的罚款。

body.en:
John Bolton, a former national security adviser to Donald Trump, has pleaded guilty to mishandling classified security information as part of notes he compiled for a book.

Bolton, now a prominent critic of the US president, was indicted on 18 counts related to improper handling of classified material, and initially pleaded not guilty.

On Friday, he admitted to a single charge of illegal retention of classified information. The documents he retained included diary entries containing national defence information, some of it classified at the top secret level.

Bolton faces a prison sentence of up to five years and has agreed to pay $2.25m (£1.7m) in fines, prosecutors said.

Bolton will also debrief national security officials on the classified information he illegally retained as well as perform 100 hours of community service, the BBC's US partner CBS News reported.

After the judge read the allegations against Bolton in court on Friday, including about sending diary entries with sensitive information to his family members, Bolton said the accusations were accurate.

"I did your honor," Bolton said about whether he committed the actions at hand today. He added he was "sorry for it."

Trump posted on Truth Social saying: "Hopefully, he will be dealt with harshly."

Speaking to reporters after the hearing, US Attorney Kelly Hayes said Bolton knew how to handle classified information and with whom he could share it.

"He also knew the damage to national security that could be caused by mishandling that sensitive information," she said. "Nevertheless, as Mr Bolton just admitted, he put our national security at grave risk in violation of the law."

In a statement, Bolton's lawyer Abbe Lowell said his client did "what real leaders do".

"He took responsibility for a mistake he made, thereby saving the government resources to pursue a case that could expose additional sensitive information," Lowell said. "By contrast, President Trump thumbed his nose at the classified information laws, took actual classified documents to his Florida mansion, interfered with the investigation of that conduct, and has never accepted any accountability for his conduct."

Trump was charged in 2023 with illegally retaining classified defence information, but the case was later dismissed after he was re-elected.

Bolton was fired from Trump's first administration in 2019. His 2020 memoir, The Room Where It Happened, recounted his time working under Trump, portraying him as a president who was ill-informed about geopolitics.

The White House filed a lawsuit to block publication of the book, arguing that it contained classified information and had not been properly vetted. A judge denied the request and the book was released days later.

body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)的前国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿(John Bolton)承认在他为一本书编写的笔记中错误处理机密安全信息。 博尔顿现在是美国总统的著名批评者，被指控 18 项与不当处理机密材料有关的罪名，但博尔顿最初拒不不认罪。 周五，他承认了一项非法保留机密信息的指控。他保留的文件包括包含国防信息的日记，其中一些属于绝密级别。 检察官称，博尔顿面临最高五年的监禁，并同意支付 225 万美元（170 万英镑）的罚款。 据 BBC 美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，博尔顿还将向国家安全官员汇报他非法保留的机密信息，并进行 100 小时的社区服务。 法官周五在法庭上宣读了对博尔顿的指控，包括向其家人发送含有敏感信息的日记后，博尔顿表示这些指控是准确的。 “我尊重你的名誉，”博尔顿在谈到他今天是否实施了手头的行动时说道。他补充说他对此“感到抱歉”。 特朗普在Truth Social上发帖称：“希望他会受到严厉对待。” 美国检察官凯利·海耶斯在听证会后对记者表示，博尔顿知道如何处理机密信息以及他可以与谁分享这些信息。 “他还知道敏感信息处理不当可能会对国家安全造成损害，”她说。 “尽管如此，正如博尔顿先生刚刚承认的那样，他违反了法律，将我们的国家安全置于严重风险之中。” 博尔顿的律师阿贝·洛厄尔在一份声明中表示，他的当事人做了“真正的领导人所做的事”。 洛厄尔说：“他为自己所犯的错误承担了责任，从而节省了政府资源来追查可能暴露更多敏感信息的案件。” “相比之下，特朗普总统对机密信息法嗤之以鼻，将实际的机密文件带到了他佛罗里达州的豪宅，干涉了对该行为的调查，并且从未接受过对其行为的任何责任。” 特朗普于2023年被指控非法保留机密国防信息，但该案后来在他连任后被驳回。 博尔顿于 2019 年被特朗普第一届政府解雇。他 2020 年的回忆录《发生的房间》讲述了他在特朗普手下工作的时光，将他描绘成一位对地缘政治一无所知的总统。 白宫提起诉讼，阻止该书出版，称其包含机密信息且未经适当审查。法官拒绝了这一请求，几天后这本书就被出版了。 美国司法部随后开...

reflection.en: This news reminds us that integrity in handling responsibilities, even those seemingly small, is crucial, especially for those entrusted with public trust. Yahweh's word suggests that faithfulness in one area reflects a broader character, and unfaithfulness can have significant consequences.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻提醒我们，在履行职责时保持诚信至关重要，特别是对于那些被赋予公众信任的人。雅伟的话语表明，在一个领域中的忠诚反映了更广泛的品格，而不忠则可能带来严重的后果。

title.en: Venezuela earthquake toll passes 900 as search intensifies for hundreds trapped under the rubble
title.zh: 委内瑞拉地震死亡人数超过900人，搜救人员加紧寻找数百名被困在废墟下的人

summary.en: The death toll from the Venezuela earthquake has exceeded 900, with search efforts intensifying for hundreds believed to be trapped under rubble. Over 50,000 people have been reported missing as survivors continue to dig through the debris.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉地震造成的死亡人数已超过900人，搜救人员正在加紧寻找据信被困在废墟下的数百人。据报道，超过5万人失踪，幸存者仍在废墟中挖掘。

body.en:
The search has intensified for tens of thousands reported missing in Venezuela as the death toll from two major earthquakes surpassed 900.

Venezuela's government said on Friday that 172 people remained trapped, 920 were dead, and more than 3,000 were injured after two magnitude 7.2 and 7.5 quakes hit within a minute of one another and devastated parts of the country's north on Wednesday evening, local time.

Witnesses reported hearing cries from people trapped alive under concrete and metal.

The event triggered an outpouring of support from nations across the world , but nearly two days later, foreign rescue teams and aid had just begun to reach hard-hit areas.

Frustration is mounting in Venezuela over equipment shortages and limited official presence.

Residents in the hardest-hit state, La Guaria, reported digging through the rubble with their hands, and complained of a lack of equipment, as volunteers ferried supplies on motorcycles from nearby Caracas and Valencia.

Arminda Gómez wept as she called out for her missing grandson and pregnant daughter.

"Please help me find my daughter, to see if she is trapped under the rubble," she pleaded.

Interim president Delcy Rodriguez visited La Guaira on Friday after the area was declared a "disaster zone."

The coastal city was without electricity, and many residents spent the night in the streets or searching for their relatives, according to AFP reporters.

Despite initially thanking the volunteers, Rodriguez and other officials later told people to stay away from La Guaira city because clogged roads were making rescue operations more difficult.

They announced roads would be closed starting at 8pm (midnight GMT) except to official and registered response teams.

Rodriguez said the government was creating a $200 million reconstruction fund for damaged hospitals and homes in a national address late Wednesday, as she declared a state of emergency.

The quakes struck a nation already weakened by decades of economic and political turmoil that has impoverished residents, driven millions abroad and weakened infrastructure.

The 7.5-magnitude earthquake was Venezuela's most powerful since 29 October, 1900, when a 7.7-magnitude tremor struck offshore.

A United States geological survey estimated more than 10,000 deaths were possible, which would make the event one of Latin America's deadliest earthquakes of the last century.

UN chief Antonio Guterres said he was "deeply saddened" by the disaster as the global body vowed to assist Venezuela.

The strongest quake to hit Venezuela in 126 years will require "massive collective efforts," UN aid chief Tom Fletcher...
body.zh: 随着两次大地震造成的死亡人数超过 900 人，委内瑞拉加大了对数万名失踪人员的搜寻力度。 委内瑞拉政府周五表示，当地时间周三晚间，委内瑞拉北部部分地区在一分钟内发生两次7.2级和7.5级地震，造成172人被困，920人死亡，3000多人受伤。 目击者称，他们听到了被困在混凝土和金属下的人们的呼喊声。 这一事件引发了世界各国的大力支持，但近两天后，外国救援队和援助物资才刚刚开始抵达重灾区。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 委内瑞拉因设备短缺和官方存在有限而感到沮丧。 受灾最严重的拉瓜里亚州的居民报告说，他们用手在废墟中挖掘，并抱怨缺乏设备，而志愿者则用摩托车从附近的加拉加斯和巴伦西亚运送物资。 阿明达·戈麦斯哭泣着呼唤失踪的孙子和怀孕的女儿。 “请帮我找到我的女儿，看看她是否被困在废墟下，”她恳求道。 在该地区被宣布为“灾区”后，临时总统德尔西·罗德里格斯于周五访问了拉瓜伊拉。 据法新社记者报道，这座沿海城市没有电，许多居民在街上过夜或寻找亲人。 尽管罗德里格斯和其他官员最初感谢志愿者，但后来告诉人们远离拉瓜伊拉市，因为道路堵塞使救援行动变得更加困难。 他们宣布从晚上 8 点（格林威治标准时间午夜）开始关闭道路，官方和注册响应团队除外。 罗德里格斯周三晚间在全国讲话中表示，政府正在为受损的医院和房屋设立 2 亿美元的重建基金，同时宣布进入紧急状态。 这次地震袭击的国家已经因数十年的经济和政治动荡而变得虚弱，导致居民陷入贫困，数百万人流亡海外，基础设施也遭到削弱。 这次7.5级地震是委内瑞拉自1900年10月29日发生7.7级地震以来最强烈的地震。 美国地质调查估计，可能有超过 10,000 人死亡，这将使该事件成为上世纪拉丁美洲最致命的地震之一。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯表示，他对这场灾难“深感悲痛”，联合国发誓要援助委内瑞拉。 联合国援助负责人汤姆·弗莱彻 (Tom Fletcher) 表示，委内瑞拉将遭遇 126 年来最强烈的地震，需要“大规模的集体努力”。

reflection.en: The immense loss of life and the anguish of searching for the missing in Venezuela remind us of the deep pain that grips humanity in the face of tragedy. Revelation 21:4 offers a profound hope that one day Yahweh will wipe away every tear, and death, mourning, crying, and pain will be no more. Until that day, we hold onto this promise, even as we grieve...

title.en: Iran strikes United States-linked targets, accuses US of 'blatant violation' of peace deal
title.zh: 伊朗指责美国在袭击无人机和雷达站后“公然违反”和平协议

summary.en: The US military stated it conducted strikes on several Iranian sites on Friday, following an earlier Iranian attack on a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz.
summary.zh: 美国军方表示，在伊朗袭击霍尔木兹海峡的一艘货船后，美军于周五袭击了几个伊朗地点。

body.en:
Iran has struck targets linked to United States forces in response to US airstrikes on its southern coast as each side continues to accuse the other of violating an agreement meant to end the ‌four-month-old war.

Iran's foreign ministry did not identify the locations of its "defensive" attacks on Saturday, which it said were a response to "the barbaric airstrikes" by the US on its coastal surveillance facilities, which it said also violated the ‌United Nations Charter.

Later, Bahrain, which hosts the US Navy's Fifth Fleet, condemned what it said was an Iranian drone attack on its territory as a flagrant violation of its sovereignty and a threat to its security, adding that it reserved the right to defend itself.

The US did not immediately respond to Iran's report of striking American targets, a tactic that has sought to undermine US allies in the region during the conflict.

Iranian state television said the country's Revolutionary Guards had delivered "a decisive response" after US forces hit a communications tower in the port city of Sirik.

The US military said its forces struck Iranian missile and drone storage sites and coastal radar locations on Friday in response to an Iranian attack on a cargo ship transiting the strategic Strait of Hormuz on Thursday.

In a statement on Saturday, the Iranian foreign ministry said the attacks were "a blatant violation" of the memorandum of understanding to end the war.

Iran has not acknowledged responsibility for the attack on the cargo ship but asserted its authority to regulate shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, saying vessels must ‌comply with routes designated by Iran and warning Gulf states against siding with the US.

It also said the Iran-US interim agreement gave it control over ship traffic through the strategic waterway.

US President Donald Trump blamed the attack on Iran and said it violated last week's agreement.

"The unwarranted aggression against commercial shipping by Iranian forces clearly violated the ceasefire," US Central Command said in its statement announcing the strikes, which it called "a powerful response to yesterday’s attack on a commercial ship that was transiting the Strait of Hormuz".

The US military said it would continue to provide "safe passage coordination and support" to commercial vessels transiting the strait.

Iranian state media, citing an unnamed military source, reported the strike at the port of Sirik after an explosion was heard there.

title.en: Fact check: Throwing cold water on heat wave disinformation
title.zh: 事实核查：给热浪虚假信息泼冷水

summary.en: DW conducted a fact-check on various pieces of disinformation circulating in Europe during a heat wave, including an outdated air-conditioning law, a health myth about sleeping with a fan, and recurring climate change hoax allegations.
summary.zh: 德国之声对欧洲热浪期间流传的各种虚假信息进行了事实核查，其中包括一项过时的空调法律、关于开风扇睡觉的健康谣言以及反复出现的“气候变化骗局”指控。

body.en:
An outdated air-conditioning law, a viral health myth about sleeping with the fan on and the age-old climate change hoax allegation: DW checked what's spreading in Europe's heat wave.

With temperatures of more than 40 degrees Celsius (104 degrees Fahrenheit) this week, much of Europe is in a heat -induced stupor.

France received the worst of it, recording its highest-ever temperature on Tuesday, leaving thousands of homes without electricity. More than 55 people have drowned  as residents have jumped in the water to try to cool down. 

Extreme weather typically brings a storm of disinformation with it; this heat wave is no different.

The message "must connect to something people are directly affected by," Anna Siewiorek, head of climate disinformation resilience at the Poland-based Climate&Strategy Foundation, told DW.

"We feel the heat waves, we feel the storms or floods — and we're emotionally affected by it because we have economic fear, we fear about our loved ones, for the infrastructure we built and so on."

DW Fact check took a look at some of these false and misleading claims. Here are the cold, hard facts. 

Claim : "Spain is banning people from setting their air-con below 27C," one user wrote in a post  viewed more than 800,000 times.

That claim is a screenshot of a Time Out headline  written on August 3, 2022. At the time, the Spanish government temporarily set that rule in response to Russia's invasion of Ukraine  and the resulting energy crisis in 2022.

The Spanish government  limited the heating and cooling temperature to 19 and 27 Celsius (66 and 80 Fahrenheit) . The royal decree-law was only ever applied  to public buildings and shops, and expired a year later.

Other countries took similar steps at the time: Germany mandated that lights be switched off around monuments, France instituted fines if air-conditioned  shops left their doors open and Ireland handed out grants to insulate attics and cavity walls. 

Claim : "Sleeping with a fan on is extremely dangerous and most people do it every single night," wrote another user in a post  viewed 1.7 million times. The post describes how a fan launches "a silent attack on your respiratory system" by evaporating moisture from your mouth and nose, drying out your eyes and causing a stuffy nose or a "pounding headache."

It's true that fans can dry out the eyes, nose and mouth, but the claim is wildly overstated.

The World Health Organization,  the  Centers for Disease Control and Prevention  in the US and the UK's National Health Service all recommend using an electric fan during extreme heat.

Peer-reviewed research backs this up. A 2019 sleep study published in Indoor Air found elderly...
body.zh: 过时的空调法、开着风扇睡觉的病毒式健康神话以及古老的气候变化骗局指控：德国之声调查了欧洲热浪的传播情况。 本周气温超过 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度），欧洲大部分地区都处于炎热的昏迷状态。 法国遭遇了最严重的天气，周二创下历史最高气温，导致数千户家庭断电。由于居民跳入水中试图降温，已有超过 55 人溺水身亡。 极端天气通常会带来大量虚假信息。这次热浪也不例外。 气候与战略基金会气候虚假信息复原力主管安娜·西维奥雷克(Anna Siewiorek)告诉德国之声，这一信息“必须与人们直接受到影响的事物联系起来”。 “我们感受到热浪，我们感受到风暴或洪水——我们在情感上受到它的影响，因为我们有经济恐惧，我们担心我们所爱的人，我们建造的基础设施等等。” 德国之声事实调查对其中一些虚假和误导性的说法进行了调查。这是冷酷无情的事实。 声称：“西班牙禁止人们将空调温度设置在 27 摄氏度以下，”一位用户在浏览次数超过 80 万次的帖子中写道。 该说法是 2022 年 8 月 3 日撰写的 Time Out 标题的屏幕截图。当时，西班牙政府临时制定了该规则，以应对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰以及由此引发的 2022 年能源危机。 西班牙政府将供暖和制冷温度限制在 19 摄氏度和 27 摄氏度。皇家法令仅适用于公共建筑和商店。一年后就过期了。 当时其他国家也采取了类似的措施：德国强制要求关闭纪念碑周围的灯光，法国对开着空调的商店处以罚款，爱尔兰则拨款资助阁楼和空心墙的隔热。 声称：“开着风扇睡觉是极其危险的，大多数人每晚都会这样做，”另一位用户在一篇被浏览了 170 万次的帖子中写道。这篇文章描述了粉丝如何对你的呼吸系统发起“无声攻击”，蒸发你口腔和鼻子中的水分，使你的眼睛干燥，并导致鼻塞或“剧烈头痛”。 确实，粉丝会让眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴变得干燥，但这种说法被过分夸大了。 世界卫生组织、美国疾病控制与预防中心和英国国家卫生服务中心都建议在酷热时使用电风扇。 同行评审的研究支持了这一点。 《室内空气》(Indoor Air) 上发表的 2019 年睡眠研究发现，老年参与者的睡眠质量同样好——……

reflection.en: In an age of rapid information spread, it is wise to pause and consider the source and veracity of claims, especially during times of public concern. Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to be prudent, not gullible, in how we receive and share information.
reflection.zh: 在信息快速传播的时代，尤其是在公众关注的时期，明智的做法是停下来思考信息来源和主张的真实性。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们在接收和分享信息时要谨慎，不要轻信。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: 'Operation Purgatory': Magyar moves to demolish Orban system
title.zh: 匈牙利新政府启动“炼狱行动”，着手拆除欧尔班体系

summary.en: The new Hungarian government has initiated "Operation Purgatory" to dismantle the system of former Prime Minister Viktor Orban. The government's stated priorities include combating corruption, reforming the media landscape, and strengthening democratic institutions.
summary.zh: 匈牙利新政府启动“炼狱行动”，迅速着手拆除前总理维克多·欧尔班的体系。此次行动的重点是打击腐败、改革媒体并保护民主。

body.en:
The new Hungarian government is moving swiftly to dismantle the system of former PM Viktor Orban. The focus is on fighting corruption, reforming the media and protecting democracy.

Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar  and his government are setting a fast pace of reform.

In his first few weeks in office, Magyar lifted EU blockades introduced by his predecessor, Viktor Orban , and launched a dialogue with Ukraine , which Orban had labeled "The Empire of Evil."

Back home in Budapest, the parliament approved cuts to the salaries of lawmakers and ministers and limited a prime minister's time in office to a maximum two terms.

But with these changes under his belt, Magyar has now turned his attention to the substance of his predecessor's regime.

Orban had laid plans that stretched decades into the future: In the event of his party losing the election, civil servants who would be difficult to replace would sabotage the work of new governments. In addition, billions had been squirreled away to continue financing Orban's network.

Thanks to a comfortable two-thirds majority in parliament, the government of Magyar and his Tisza party can now dismantle these structures.

In an address to parliament on Monday, Magyar called Orban's style of rule the "mafia system."  He promised to root it out completely using what he called "Operation Purgatory," a name that likely comes from Magyar's penchant for religious and historical symbols.

Magyar has promised that comprehensive investigations will be conducted to establish how Orban's family and friends as well as oligarchs and high-ranking party members lined their pockets and that illegally obtained assets will be recovered.

He has also pledged that state institutions, the judiciary and the media will be reformed in such a way that renders it impossible to return to the Orban system — i.e. to the political control of state institutions and the public.

"Orban wanted to tie the hands of the next ten governments," said the online news outlet 444.hu. "The Magyar administration is now ripping up that plan."

On Tuesday, the parliament passed a first large package of laws relating to "Operation Purgatory."

Most of them were anti-corruption measures. These were key to ensuring that the European Union releases about €17 billion ($19.3 billion) in EU funding for Hungary that was frozen by Brussels because of a perceived risk of corruption during Orban's time in power.

The timing was very important because a deadline for the payment of one large tranche of these funds, some €10.4 billion, passes in August.

One of the most important measures is the abolition of what is known as public interest asset management foundations (KEKVA), private foundations that hold and manage universities, cultural...
body.zh: 匈牙利新政府正在迅速采取行动，废除前总理欧尔班·维克多的制度。重点是打击腐败、改革媒体和保护民主。 匈牙利总理彼得·马扎尔和他的政府正在加快改革步伐。 在上任的头几周内，马扎尔解除了其前任欧尔班·维克多(Viktor Orban)实行的欧盟封锁，并与被欧尔班称为“邪恶帝国”的乌克兰展开对话。 回到布达佩斯，议会批准削减议员和部长的工资，并将总理的任期限制为最多两届。 但随着这些变化，马扎尔现在将注意力转向了前任政权的实质内容。 欧尔班制定了未来几十年的计划：如果他的政党在选举中失败，难以替代的公务员将破坏新政府的工作。此外，还储备了数十亿美元来继续为欧尔班的网络提供资金。 由于在议会中获得了三分之二的多数席位，马扎尔政府和他的蒂萨党现在可以拆除这些结构。 在周一向议会发表的讲话中，马扎尔将欧尔班的统治方式称为“黑手党体系”。 他承诺将通过他所谓的“炼狱行动”彻底根除它，这个名字可能来自马扎尔对宗教和历史符号的偏爱。 马扎尔承诺，将进行全面调查，查明欧尔班的家人和朋友以及寡头和高级党员如何中饱私囊，并追回非法获得的资产。 他还承诺，将对国家机构、司法机构和媒体进行改革，使其不可能回到欧尔班体系，即国家机构和公众的政治控制。 “欧尔班想要束缚接下来十届政府的手脚，”在线新闻媒体 444.hu 说。 “马扎尔政府现在正在撕毁该计划。” 周二，议会通过了第一套与“炼狱行动”相关的大型法律。 其中大部分是反腐败措施。这些对于确保欧盟向匈牙利发放约 170 亿欧元（193 亿美元）的欧盟资金至关重要，这些资金因欧尔班执政期间存在腐败风险而被布鲁塞尔冻结。 这一时机非常重要，因为其中一大笔资金（约 104 亿欧元）的支付截止日期已于 8 月份过去。 最重要的措施之一是废除所谓的公共利益资产管理基金会（KEKVA），即持有和管理大学、文化……的私人基金会。

reflection.en: When leaders prioritize justice and integrity, it brings hope and stability to a nation. The efforts to dismantle corruption and protect democratic principles reflect a commitment to governance that serves the common good. Yahweh's word reminds us that the character of those in authority profoundly impacts the well-being of the people.
reflection.zh: 当领袖们优先考虑公义和廉正时，这会给国家带来希望和稳定。拆除腐败体系和保护民主原则的努力，反映了对服务公共利益的治理的承诺。雅伟的话语提醒我们，掌权者的品格深刻影响着人民的福祉。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.

title.en: How the Iran war has disrupted Abu Dhabi's AI strategy
title.zh: 伊朗战争如何扰乱阿布扎比的人工智能战略

summary.en: Abu Dhabi's ambitions to turn the United Arab Emirates into a global hub for digital infrastructure and artificial Intelligence face pressure after the Iran war. But the country is also known for its business resilience.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Abu Dhabi's ambitions to turn the United Arab Emirates into a global hub for digital infrastructure and artificial Intelligence face pressure after the Iran war. But the country is also known for its business resilience.

When the United Arab Emirates appointed Omar Sultan Al Olama as the world's first minister of state for artificial intelligence in 2017, he promised to turn the United Arab Emirates into the world's most prepared country for AI. Only six years later, Al Olama was listed on TIME magazine's inaugural TIME100 AI list and Abu Dhabi was well underway in implementing its digital strategy .

However, after the United States and Israel attacked Iran in February, the UAE became one of Iran's key targets : Over the course of the war, thousands of Iranian missile and drone strikes were aimed at local offices and data centers operated by global companies such as Amazon, Google, Microsoft and Nvidia.

The news magazine The Conversation reported that the war also raised questions about the safety of undersea cables which are essential for data centers and other digital infrastructure. Furthermore, the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz by Iran , and later by the United States , has delayed hardware deliveries.

"Data centers have long become critical infrastructure and need to be better protected just like oil refineries or desalination plants," Sebastian Sons, a senior researcher at the German think tank CARPO, told DW.

Despite the impact of the war on the Gulf state, observers point out that not everything is different.

"The political risk profile has changed, but the fundamentals haven't changed," Mohammed Soliman, a senior fellow at the Middle East Institute in Washington, told DW. "The UAE still lies at the intersection of capital flows between East and West, it still has the energy, land and political will to build AI capabilities at scale."

In the past, the Gulf region has weathered different crises, from the financial crisis of the late 2000s to the COVID-19 pandemic and previous Gulf conflicts, all of which tested the Gulf business model , said Sons, adding that "during all these crises, the UAE has demonstrated a high level of resilience and found ways to reinvent itself and deal with such strategic situations."

In his view, significant damage would only occur if the Iran conflict continued for a long time and the UAE couldn't find a way to adapt its business model.

However, it remains to be seen in what way the UAE's global compute diplomacy strategy will pivot in the short, medium and long term. In May, a planned $1 billion mega-data-center project in Kenya was called off, Business Insider Africa reported.

It may well be that Abu Dhabi's AI strategy, dubbed "UAE AI Strategy 2031," is already  diversified...
body.zh: 阿布扎比将阿联酋打造成全球数字基础设施和人工智能中心的雄心在伊朗战争后面临压力。但该国也以其商业韧性而闻名。 2017年，阿拉伯联合酋长国任命奥马尔·苏丹·阿尔·奥拉马为全球首任人工智能国务部长时，他承诺将阿联酋打造成世界上人工智能准备最充分的国家。仅六年后，Al Olama 就被列入《时代》杂志首届 TIME100 AI 榜单，阿布扎比正在顺利实施其数字战略。 然而，在美国和以色列二月份袭击伊朗后，阿联酋成为伊朗的重点目标之一：在战争过程中，伊朗数千次导弹和无人机袭击针对亚马逊、谷歌、微软和英伟达等跨国公司运营的当地办事处和数据中心。 新闻杂志《对话》报道称，战争还引发了人们对海底电缆安全性的质疑，而海底电缆对于数据中心和其他数字基础设施至关重要。此外，伊朗以及后来美国对霍尔木兹海峡的封锁导致了硬件交付的延迟。 德国智库 CARPO 高级研究员 Sebastian Sons 告诉德国之声：“数据中心早已成为关键基础设施，需要像炼油厂或海水淡化厂一样得到更好的保护。” 尽管战争对这个海湾国家造成了影响，但观察人士指出，并非一切都不同了。 华盛顿中东研究所高级研究员穆罕默德·索利曼对德国之声表示：“政治风险状况已经改变，但基本面没有改变。” “阿联酋仍然位于东西方资本流动的交汇处，它仍然拥有大规模建设人工智能能力的能源、土地和政治意愿。” Sons表示，过去，海湾地区经历过不同的危机，从2000年代末的金融危机到COVID-19大流行和之前的海湾冲突，所有这些都考验着海湾地区的商业模式。他补充说，“在所有这些危机中，阿联酋表现出了高度的韧性，并找到了重塑自身和应对此类战略局势的方法。” 他认为，只有当伊朗冲突持续很长时间并且阿联酋无法找到调整其商业模式的方法时，才会造成重大损害。 然而，阿联酋的全球计算外交战略在短期、中期和长期将如何转向仍有待观察。据《非洲商业内幕》报道，5 月份，肯尼亚计划耗资 10 亿美元的大型数据中心项目被取消。 阿布扎比的人工智能战略（被称为“阿联酋人工智能战略 2031”）很可能已经多元化......

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

title.zh: 飞机撞击北京最高建筑后碎片坠落

summary.en: Social media footage captured debris falling after a small aircraft crashed into Beijing's tallest skyscraper.
summary.zh: 社交媒体视频显示，一架小型飞机撞上北京最高摩天大楼后，碎片坠落到地面。

body.en:
Video shows the moment debris from a small aircraft fell to the ground after a crash into Beijing's tallest skyscraper.

Eyewitnesses told Reuters news agency that an aircraft the size of a car crashed into the CITIC Tower, also known as China Zun, on Friday.

Social media footage captured from a building nearby showed what appeared to be a small plane on the ground. Firefighters were also seen extinguishing a fire in the tower.

CITIC Tower is a 108-storey skyscraper in Beijing's central business district and the headquarters of the state-owned conglomerate CITIC Group, one of China's largest.

It is not known if there were any casualties and there has been no immediate comment from authorities about the incident.
body.zh: 视频显示一架小型飞机撞上北京最高摩天大楼后残骸掉落地面的瞬间。 目击者告诉路透社，周五，一架汽车大小的飞机撞上了中信大厦（也称为“中国尊”）。 从附近一座建筑物捕捉到的社交媒体视频显示，地面上似乎有一架小型飞机。人们还看到消防队员正在扑灭塔内的大火。 中信大厦是北京中央商务区的一座 108 层摩天大楼，也是中国最大的国有企业集团之一的中信集团的总部。 目前尚不清楚是否有人员伤亡，当局也没有立即对这一事件发表评论。

reflection.en: News of an unexpected crash into a major building can be unsettling, reminding us of life's sudden vulnerabilities. In moments of crisis and uncertainty, Yahweh remains our steadfast refuge and strength. He is an ever-present help, offering solace and stability when the world feels shaken.
reflection.zh: 飞机意外撞击高楼的消息令人不安，提醒我们生命的脆弱和突如其来的变故。在危机和不确定性中，雅伟依然是我们坚固的避难所和力量。祂是随时的帮助，在世界动摇时赐予我们安慰和稳定。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Weather tracker: Heatwave expected to bring Germany and Poland to 40C
title.zh: 天气追踪：德国和波兰预计将迎来40摄氏度高温热浪

summary.en: An intense heatwave is expected to bring temperatures up to 40C in parts of central and northern Europe, including Germany and Poland. The Austrian Grand Prix has declared a heat hazard due to the dramatic rise in temperatures.
summary.zh: 预计一股强烈的热浪将使中欧和北欧部分地区（包括德国和波兰）的气温升至40摄氏度。由于气温急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛已宣布高温危险。

body.en: Austrian Grand Prix declares heat hazard as dramatic rise in temperatures forecast in central and northern Europe Temperatures are forecast to rise dramatically in parts of central and northern Europe this weekend as the intense heatwave continues . In Germany and Poland, highs up to or exceeding 40C (104F) are expected on both Saturday and Sunday, days after swathes of France experienced similar extreme temperatures. The Austrian Grand Prix, taking place this weekend in Spielberg, has declared a heat hazard , the first race to do so this season. Temperatures are expected to rise into the low 30s celsius during the race, almost 10C warmer than usual for the venue. Across Europe, the intense heat has led to severe thunderstorms. In the Sverdlovsk region of central Russia, a strong tornado was reported on the evening of 22 June. Rated a 3 out of 5 on the international Fujita scale, the twister injured 16 people and destroyed or damaged about 100 homes and businesses in the town of Kushva. Emergency services have been working on restoring power to the town. Tornadoes are not unheard of in Russia but are rare. Forecasters say they may become more common in future as the climate breaks down. Storm warnings remained in effect in the southern part of the country on Friday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 预计中欧和北欧气温将急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛宣布存在热危险 随着强烈热浪的持续，预计本周末中欧和北欧部分地区气温将大幅上升。在德国和波兰，预计周六和周日气温将达到或超过 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度），几天前法国大片地区也经历了类似的极端气温。本周末在斯皮尔伯格举行的奥地利大奖赛已宣布出现高温危险，这是本赛季第一场这样做的比赛。预计比赛期间气温将升至 30 摄氏度，比平时高出近 10 摄氏度。在整个欧洲，酷热导致了严重的雷暴天气。 6月22日晚，俄罗斯中部斯维尔德洛夫斯克地区报告出现强烈龙卷风。国际藤田等级评定为 3 级（满分 5 级），龙卷风造成 16 人受伤，并摧毁或损坏了库什瓦镇约 100 所房屋和企业。紧急服务部门一直致力于恢复该镇的供电。龙卷风在俄罗斯并非闻所未闻，但很罕见。预报员表示，随着气候的恶化，它们未来可能会变得更加普遍。周五，该国南部地区的风暴警告仍然有效。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic rise in temperatures across Europe reminds us that creation itself is experiencing distress. As the natural world groans under changing conditions, we are called to reflect on our interconnectedness with the earth and its well-being. This intense heatwave serves as a poignant reminder of the broader challenges facing our shared home.
reflection.zh: 欧洲气温的急剧上升提醒我们，受造界本身正在经历痛苦。当自然界在不断变化的环境下发出呻吟时，我们被呼召反思我们与地球及其福祉的相互关联。这场强烈热浪是对我们共同家园所面临的更广泛挑战的深刻提醒。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Xi Jinping has hosted more than a dozen leaders this year, as ‘middle powers’ look beyond the US
title.zh: 习近平今年接待了十几位领导人，‘中间力量’超越美国寻求合作

summary.en: China's leader, Xi Jinping, has hosted numerous world leaders this year, aiming to promote an alternative global order. This effort is reportedly aided by the perceived unpredictability of the United States, prompting 'middle powers' to explore new international alignments.
summary.zh: 中国领导人习近平今年接待了多位世界各国领导人，旨在推动一种替代性的全球秩序。据报道，美国的反复无常助长了这一努力，促使“中等强国”寻求新的国际结盟。

body.en: China’s leader wants to promote his alternative to the current world order, and his efforts are being assisted by a capricious US Xi Jinping meets Bangladesh’s new prime minister on Friday, the latest in a wave of world leaders to visit Beijing this year as the Chinese leader builds his influence and economic ties, and seeks to “shift the balance of power” away from the west. Xi’s meeting with Tarique Rahman comes less than two weeks after the Chinese leader welcomed Myanmar’s military chief-turned-president, Min Aung Hlaing, in Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国领导人希望推行他对当前世界秩序的替代方案，他的努力得到了反复无常的美国的协助。习近平周五会见了孟加拉国新总理，这是今年访问北京的一波世界领导人中最新的一位，中国领导人正在建立影响力和经济联系，并寻求“改变力量平衡”，远离西方。习近平与塔里克·拉赫曼的会面是在中国领导人在北京欢迎缅甸军方最高领导人、现任总统敏昂莱之后不到两周。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights how nations are drawn to leaders who articulate a clear vision for the future, especially when existing global structures seem uncertain. Proverbs 29:18 reminds us that without a guiding vision, people and nations can lose their way. This underscores the profound impact of leadership that offers a coherent path forward.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调，当现有的全球秩序显得不确定时，各国会被那些为未来描绘清晰愿景的领导人所吸引。箴言29:18提醒我们，没有指引的异象，人民和国家就会迷失方向。这突显了提供连贯前进道路的领导力所产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: UK to halve tariff-free steel imports to counter glut of cheap Chinese metal
title.zh: 英国将削减免关税钢材进口量以应对廉价中国金属过剩

summary.en: The UK government announced it will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports, doubling duties on quantities exceeding the new quota. This measure, mirrored by similar changes in EU limits, aims to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and support domestic industry.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布将把免关税钢材进口量减半，超出新配额的进口将加倍征收关税。此举与欧盟的类似调整相呼应，旨在应对全球廉价中国金属的过剩供应，并扶持本国产业。

body.en: Duty on imports outside new quota will double in move echoing similar changes in EU limits Business live – latest updates The UK government will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports allowed in an attempt to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and bolster its beleaguered local industry. New “safeguards” will be introduced on 1 July and will coincide with similar new limits being introduced by the EU for the same purposes. The UK said it and the EU had agreed an approach that reflected each other’s “highly interconnected supply chains” after months of negotiations over retaining tariff-free access between the markets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新配额之外的进口关税将翻倍，与欧盟限制的类似变化相呼应英国政府将允许的免关税钢铁进口量减半，以应对全球廉价中国金属供应过剩的问题，并提振陷入困境的当地工业。新的“保障措施”将于 7 月 1 日推出，并将与欧盟出于相同目的推出的类似新限制同时实施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often grapple with balancing economic interests and ensuring fair trade practices. Proverbs 11:1 reminds us that Yahweh values honest dealings and just measures in commerce. This principle encourages leaders to seek equitable solutions that promote integrity in global markets.
reflection.zh: 国家常在经济利益与确保公平贸易实践之间寻求平衡。箴言11:1提醒我们，雅伟看重商业中的诚实交易和公正的度量。这一原则鼓励领导者寻求公平的解决方案，以促进全球市场的诚信。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: What is China’s SpaceSail, and could it rival Elon Musk’s Starlink?
title.zh: 中国的“太空帆”是什么？它能与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争吗？

summary.en: China's state-backed SpaceSail project is developing a satellite internet constellation to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. With hundreds of satellites in low Earth orbit, the company is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries.
summary.zh: 中国国家支持的“太空帆”项目正在开发一个卫星互联网星座，旨在与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争。该公司目前在近地轨道拥有数百颗卫星，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判。

body.en: The company has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit but has state backing and is already reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries Elon Musk’s Starlink has long dominated the satellite internet industry, but a Chinese government-backed project is aiming to challenge its position. SpaceSail has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit compared with Starlink’s 10,000-plus. But the company says it now has enough satellites to begin its first commercial application, is scaling up at speed, and is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries to provide satellite internet coverage. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该公司在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星，但有国家支持，据报道已经与数十个国家进行谈判。埃隆·马斯克的星链长期以来一直主导着卫星互联网行业，但一个中国政府支持的项目旨在挑战其地位。与 Starlink 的 10,000 多颗卫星相比，SpaceSail 在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星。但该公司表示，它现在拥有足够的卫星来开始其首次商业应用，并且正在快速扩大规模，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判以提供卫星互联网覆盖。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As nations and companies embark on ambitious technological ventures like SpaceSail, it reminds us of the human drive to innovate and connect the world. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans to Yahweh, trusting that our efforts, when aligned with His purposes, will find success. This perspective can guide us in all our endeavors, from grand...
reflection.zh: 当各国和公司着手像“太空帆”这样雄心勃勃的技术项目时，这提醒我们人类创新和连接世界的动力。箴言16:3鼓励我们将我们的计划交托给雅伟，相信我们的努力，若与祂的旨意相符，必将成功。这种视角可以指导我们所有的努力，无论是宏伟的项目还是日常任务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Dear You review – enjoyable Chinese romdram crosses generations as it tracks down a missing husband
title.zh: 《亲爱的你》影评：一部跨越世代、追寻失踪丈夫的感人华语爱情剧情片

summary.en: The Guardian China reviews "Dear You," a Chinese romantic drama by director Lan Hongchun. The film is a multi-generational family saga, spanning from the 1940s to the present, primarily set in Bangkok, and follows the search for a husband who disappeared in Thailand.
summary.zh: 《卫报中国》评论了导演蓝鸿春的华语爱情剧情片《亲爱的你》。这部电影是一部跨越几代人的家族传奇，故事从20世纪40年代至今，主要背景设在曼谷，讲述了一个家庭寻找在泰国失踪的丈夫的故事。

body.en: Director Lan Hongchun’s family saga feels like a good old-fashioned novel as it goes in search of a man who has disappeared in Thailand With a story that ranges from the 1940s to the present and, although mostly set in Bangkok, revolving largely around Teochew-speaking Chinese from Guangdong, this generations-spanning drama feels like a good old-fashioned novel. A romantic beach read, perhaps, the kind in which coincidences and random accidents cause misunderstandings that last for decades until the truth is finally revealed. It’s sentimental in places, sure, but there’s also a fair bit of salty, bawdy humour to cut the sweetness, lashings of period colour, and impressively naturalistic performances from a mostly non-professional cast. All that has helped to make this an unexpectedly large box-office hit in the People’s Republic last month; and for non-Chinese or Thai rom-dram aficionados anywhere, it’s well worth looking out for. As the story opens in the 21st century in the Chinese city of Shantou, octogenarian Shurou (Iap Sok-jiu) is celebrating her 87th birthday, surrounded by adoring friends, family and neighbours who revere the matriarch, not least for managing to raise three kids on her own in the 1940s and 50s. Her shifty grandson Xiaowei (Hiau-ui), however, is less of a solid citizen and, having got into debt, he decides to travel to Bangkok to find out if Shurou’s husband Zheng Musheng, not seen for decades, could help out since he’s reputed to have made a fortune out there, endowed schools all over Thailand, and had a second family after abandoning Shurou. Continue reading...
body.zh: 导演兰鸿春的家庭传奇感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说，讲述了在泰国寻找失踪男子的故事。故事范围从 20 世纪 40 年代至今，虽然主要以曼谷为背景，但主要围绕来自广东的潮州华人展开，这部跨越几代人的戏剧感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说。浪漫的海滩读物，也许是那种巧合和偶然的事故会导致持续数十年的误会，直到真相最终揭晓的类型。当然，它在某些地方是感伤的，但也有一些咸味、下流的幽默来削弱甜蜜，充满时代色彩，以及来自大多数非专业演员的令人印象深刻的自然主义表演。所有这些都使得该片上个月在中华人民共和国取得了意想不到的票房大成功。对于任何地方的非中国或泰国的浪漫剧爱好者来说，这都非常值得一看。故事发生在 21 世纪的中国汕头市，八十多岁的淑柔（叶淑如饰）正在庆祝她的 87 岁生日，周围都是崇拜这位女族长的朋友、家人和邻居，尤其是她在 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代设法独自抚养三个孩子。然而，她狡猾的孙子小伟（孝仪饰）却不是一个踏实的公民，负债累累，他决定前往曼谷，看看书柔数十年未见的丈夫郑木胜是否可以帮忙，因为他在外面发了大财，为泰国各地的学校捐款，并在抛弃书柔后有了第二个家庭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The multi-generational search for a missing husband in "Dear You" powerfully illustrates the enduring nature of family bonds. This long quest reflects the deep commitment inherent in marriage, where two become one, a union that transcends time and distance. It reminds us that true connection often calls for steadfastness, even in the face of profound...
reflection.zh: 电影《亲爱的你》中跨越几代人寻找失踪丈夫的故事，有力地展现了家庭纽带的持久性。这场漫长的寻觅反映了婚姻中固有的深刻承诺，夫妻二人成为一体，这种结合超越了时间和距离。它提醒我们，真正的连接往往需要坚韧不拔，即使面对巨大的不确定性也是如此。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: Dettol apologises after ‘toxic men’ advert sparks backlash in China
title.zh: 滴露因“有毒男性”广告在中国引发反弹后致歉

summary.en: British hygiene brand Dettol has apologized and withdrawn an advertisement in China that sparked widespread condemnation. The advert, which the company stated was intended to criticize “toxic men,” featured a man seeking a “clean and untouched” woman.
summary.zh: 英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告引发广泛谴责后，已致歉并撤回该广告。滴露公司称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，但其内容却描绘了一名男子寻找“干净纯洁”女性的情节。

body.en: British disinfectant brand withdraws advert about a man’s efforts to find a ‘clean and untouched’ woman The British hygiene brand Dettol has apologised after an advertisement released in China, which it said was intended to criticise “toxic men”, was widely condemned on social media as offensive to women. The five-minute advert for a multipurpose disinfectant, released across many online platforms at the end of May, features a man comparing his girlfriend with his former partner. Learning that his former girlfriend previously lived with someone else, the man likens their relationship to a “secondhand service”. He then tells his friends that he intends to find a “clean and untouched” woman for whom he can be the first sexual partner. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国消毒剂品牌撤回有关男性努力寻找“干净、未受影响”女性的广告英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告道歉，称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，该广告在社交媒体上受到广泛谴责，认为该广告冒犯了女性。五月底，多用途消毒剂的五分钟广告在多个在线平台上发布，其中一名男子将他的女朋友与他的前伴侣进行了比较。当得知他的前女友以前与别人住在一起时，该男子将他们的关系比作“二手服务”。然后他告诉他的朋友，他打算找一个“干净、未受污染”的女人作为他的第一个性伴侣。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The controversy surrounding Dettol's advertisement highlights the importance of recognizing the inherent dignity of every individual. When an advert reduces women to an object defined by their perceived “purity” or “untouched” status, it diminishes the profound truth that all people, male and female, are created in the image of Yahweh. This reminds us to...
reflection.zh: 滴露广告引发的争议，凸显了承认每个人固有尊严的重要性。当一个广告将女性贬低为由其所谓的“纯洁”或“未被触碰”状态来定义的客体时，它就削弱了一个深刻的真理：所有的人，无论男女，都是按雅伟的形象被造的。这提醒我们要维护他人的价值，反映出神赋予每个生命的尊贵。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Chinese supercomputer leapfrogs best US machines to be ranked world’s fastest
title.zh: 中国超级计算机超越美国最强机器，位居世界第一

summary.en: China's LineShine supercomputer has been ranked the world's fastest, marking the first time since 2017 that a Chinese machine has topped the global Top500 list, which measures technological prowess.
summary.zh: 中国的LineShine超级计算机被评为全球最快，这是自2017年以来，中国机器首次在衡量全球科技实力的全球超级计算机500强榜单中位居榜首。

body.en: China’s LineShine debuts at number one in Top500 – a list sometimes viewed as a national measure of global tech prowess A supercomputer in China now outranks its US counterparts as the world’s most powerful. It is the first time since 2017 that a Chinese computer has topped a list sometimes viewed as a measure of a nation’s technological prowess. The LineShine computer in Shenzhen displaced top-ranked US computer El Capitan in the Top500 rankings released on Tuesday. It was LineShine’s debut on the list. Continue reading...

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher Jimmy Lai honored by DW
title.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获德国之声表彰

summary.en: Jimmy Lai, a Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher, has been honored by DW. He founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper before being sentenced to 20 years in prison. His son stated that the award signifies that those who advocate for the freedom of others are not alone.
summary.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获得德国之声表彰。他在被判处20年监禁前，创办了香港最大的亲民主报纸。他的儿子表示，这个奖项表明那些为他人自由而奋斗的人“从不孤单”。

body.en:
Before being imprisoned for 20 years, Jimmy Lai founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper. His son said the award shows that those who fight for the freedom of others "are never alone."

Arriving in Hong Kong as a penniless 12-year-old stowaway from southern China, Jimmy Lai sought only freedom and a future. At the time, Lai could never have imagined how his life would become forever intertwined with this former British colony.

"I'll sink with the ship, because this place gives me everything," said Lai in an interview about Hong Kong with DW a few months before he was taken into custody in December 2020. He was one of the first high-profile figures to be targeted under a "national security law" imposed on Hong Kong by Beijing following a crackdown on pro-democracy protests.

Beijing had said the law would restore Hong Kong "from chaos to order" after demonstrations in 2019 opposing an extradition bill morphed into massive protests against Beijing encroaching on Hong Kong's civil liberties .

Since then, the pro-democracy media mogul has spent more than 2,000 days in solitary confinement in Hong Kong's maximum-security Stanley Prison.

Lai's years-long trial ended this February, when the 78-year-old was sentenced to 20 years in prison for "colluding with foreign forces." While he had pleaded not guilty to all charges, his legal team said he will not appeal.

The sentence is the heaviest punishment handed down so far under the national security law, and Lai's trial has symbolized for many people the severe erosion of press freedom in Hong Kong as part of Beijing's broader strategy to silence critical voices.

In recognition of his defense of press freedom and freedom of speech, DW honored Jimmy Lai with this year's Freedom of Speech Award  at the annual Global Media Forum in Bonn, Germany, on Tuesday.

"While we have spoken freely in the defence of independent media, Jimmy, who founded an independent media company because he believed in the rights of the Hong Kong people to receive information, is locked away for those beliefs," Jodie Ginsberg, CEO of the Committee to Protect Journalists, said in a speech honoring Lai.

"The attacks on Apple Daily and its counterparts in Hong Kong presaged the far greater attacks on civil liberties in the years that followed. Jimmy Lai saw this and spoke out. We can honor him today not only by fighting for his freedom, but by defending the freedoms for which he was jailed."

Since 2015, the DW Freedom of Speech Award has honored journalists and human rights defenders as a way to call attention to restrictions on press freedom and concerning human rights situations around the world.

body.zh: 在入狱20年之前，黎智英创办了香港最大的民主报纸。他的儿子表示，该奖项表明那些为他人自由而奋斗的人“永远不会孤单”。 黎智英 (Jimmy Lai) 12 岁，身无分文，从中国南方偷渡到香港，他只寻求自由和未来。当时，黎智英无法想象他的生活将如何与这个前英国殖民地永远交织在一起。 黎智英在 2020 年 12 月被拘留前几个月接受德国之声采访时表示，“我将与船一起沉没，因为这个地方给了我一切。”黎智英是北京在镇压亲民主抗议活动后对香港实施的“国家安全法”中首批成为目标的知名人士之一。 在2019年反对引渡法案的示威演变成针对北京侵犯香港公民自由的大规模抗议活动后，北京曾表示，该法律将使香港“从混乱中恢复秩序”。 此后，这位亲民主媒体大亨在香港戒备森严的赤柱监狱中被单独监禁了 2000 多天。 黎智英长达数年的审判于今年 2 月结束，78 岁的他因“勾结外国势力”被判处 20 年徒刑。虽然他对所有指控均表示不认罪，但他的法律团队表示他不会上诉。 这一判决是迄今为止根据国家安全法作出的最重处罚，对许多人来说，黎智英的审判象征着香港新闻自由的严重侵蚀，而这是北京压制批评声音的更广泛战略的一部分。 为了表彰黎智英对新闻自由和言论自由的捍卫，周二在德国波恩举行的年度全球媒体论坛上，德国之声授予黎智英今年的言论自由奖。 保护记者委员会首席执行官朱迪·金斯伯格(Jodie Ginsberg)在向黎智英致敬的演讲中表示：“虽然我们畅所欲言地捍卫独立媒体，但吉米因为相信香港人民有权接收信息而创立了一家独立媒体公司，但他却因为这些信念而被关起来。” “对《苹果日报》及其香港同行的攻击预示着随后几年对公民自由的更大攻击。黎智英看到了这一点并大声疾呼。今天我们不仅可以通过为他的自由而奋斗，而且可以通过捍卫他被监禁的自由来向他致敬。” 自 2015 年以来，德国之声言论自由奖一直向记者和人权捍卫者授予荣誉，以此呼吁人们关注世界各地对新闻自由的限制和人权状况。 黎智英的儿子塞巴斯蒂安·赖（Sebastien Lai）是黎智英释放的长期倡导者，他在四月份告诉德国之声，“那些反抗的人......

body.zh: 中国正在推动电动汽车转型，但欧洲和其他国家正在快速追赶。电动汽车变得越来越便宜、效率越来越高，而且行驶距离比以往任何时候都更远。 全球电动汽车 (EV) 市场的增长速度远远快于预期。短短六年内，销量增长了十倍，到 2025 年，全球电动汽车销量将达到约 2100 万辆。 中国和欧洲处于领先地位，但世界其他地区的市场也在快速增长。 中国长期以来一直在投资太阳能和风能以及电池技术——电动汽车最关键的组成部分。 得益于先进的研究和大规模生产，电动汽车电池成本大幅下降。如今，它们的成本仅为 10 年前的四分之一，而且价格还在继续下降。 中国是世界上最大的汽车市场，消费者正在从政府的产业战略中获益。自 2024 年以来，电动汽车的成本低于内燃机汽车，国家多年来一直在迅速扩大充电基础设施，而且中国的电力非常实惠。 2015年，电动汽车仅占中国新车销量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，这一比例已攀升至 61%。 电动汽车依靠电力运行并通过电缆充电。在全球范围内，三分之二的电动汽车是所谓的电池电动汽车 (BEV)，仅由电力驱动。剩下的三分之一还配备了燃气发动机，用于长途旅行时的备用——这些被称为增程电动汽车 (EREV) 或插电式混合动力电动汽车 (PHEV)。 相比之下，所谓的混合动力电动汽车 (HEV) 始终需要汽油或柴油来为其内燃机提供动力。电动机提供一些帮助，仅通过再生制动产生电力。这项技术在一定程度上降低了城市驾驶的燃油消耗，但混合动力汽车在国际统计中并未被算作电动汽车。 2018年，电动汽车仅占欧盟新车注册量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，售出的新车中近三分之一是电动汽车。 北欧处于领先地位。在挪威，现在销售的几乎所有新车都是电动汽车（99%），其次是丹麦（82%）和瑞典（65%）。该地区各国政府支持气候友好型出行，并正在扩大充电基础设施。 在英国，2026 年 4 月注册的新车中有 39% 是电动汽车，其次是德国（37%）和法国（32%）。在这三个国家，电动汽车销量与去年同月相比都翻了一番。 近年来，美国市场陷入停滞。 2023 年至 2025 年间，电动汽车占...

title.en: Fourth positive bird flu case confirmed amid surge of calls to animal disease hotline
title.zh: 第四例禽流感病例确诊，动物疾病热线接报量激增

summary.en: Officials have confirmed a fourth case of bird flu, leading to over four hundred reports to the emergency animal hotline in just over a week.
summary.zh: 官员已确认第四例禽流感病例，导致在一周多时间内，紧急动物热线接到超过四百个报告。

body.en:
Western Australia has confirmed its third positive bird flu case, the fourth recorded in Australia in one week.

The deadly H5 strain of avian influenza was found in a giant petrel discovered in Quindalup, on the state's south-west coast, and confirmed by the CSIRO's Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness on Saturday morning.

There have been four positive cases of H5 bird flu in Australia since 20 June, when the federal government confirmed that two migratory seabirds suspected to be infected with the virus returned positive results.

These first two cases, a brown skua and a giant petrel, were found in the remote Cape Le Grand area, east of Esperance.

The government said on Saturday that the results of a fifth possible positive case, in another giant petrel found west of Esperance, were pending.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In the week since reports first emerged of a suspected H5 influenza case on 19 June, Western Australians have made more than 400 reports to the Emergency Animal Disease hotline.

Of these reports, 53 have been prioritised for further investigation by the Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development.

Across the state, 17 negative results have been recorded in the Esperance area, Mid West, Great Southern, South West, Peel and the Perth metropolitan area.

Australia was the last continent to record cases of the highly contagious and deadly strain of bird flu.

So far, three of four confirmed cases were in migratory seabirds found in Western Australia.

South Australia also detected a case in a giant petrel found in the Fleurieu Peninsula on 14 June.

Australia's chief veterinary officer, Dr Beth Cookson, said on Saturday that there was so far no indication the disease had spread to domesticated animals.

"At this stage, there have only been detections in vagrant migratory seabirds that occasionally visit southern Australia," Cookson said.

"There remains no evidence of any mass mortality events and there are no detections in poultry or in our agricultural production system.

Cookson said genomic sequencing indicated that the virus infecting the first confirmed wild bird case in Australia was related to an outbreak on the Heard and McDonald Islands, about 4,100km south-west of Perth.

A recent study found the disease killed 13,000 elephant seal pups on the sub-Antarctic islands, which are Australian external territories.

The arrival of H5 bird flu in Australia prompted grave concerns from scientists over its potential to devastate native wildlife and domesticated bird species.

In both poultry and wild birds, H5 viruses can spread rapidly and cause severe disease, neurological defects, and sudden death....
